messages:
leah_sales: Hi team, Acme procurement asked for a minimal assurance bundle for the POC: SOC2 excerpt, redacted ISO diagram for staging, a signed pen-test attestation we can present, and a way for their external scanner to run against staging. Also want rough pricing if we need isolated staging.

tonY_se: For scanner access we recommend a time-windowed approach + presigned S3 for report upload. No long-lived creds.

tonY_se: Example presign: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc/report.zip --expires-in 86400`

maria_compliance: We can provide SOC2 cover pages and scope, plus a redacted control matrix. Network diagram must hide hostnames/IPs. Our pen-test attestation template allows a third-party scan under NDA; it doesn't certify results.

procurement_acme: Procurement note: signatory block must show full legal name and city. Also prefer evening scan next Tue.

ops-bot: Preparing staging for scan (job id: j-3344). Will publish ephemeral IP and presign link when ready.

tonY_se: Evening scan OK. For a short isolated window we can usually absorb cost for the POC; reserved single-tenant month would add ~25% to the seat. I'll confirm with infra ops.

maria_compliance: If procurement redlines the attestation beyond adding name/city, legal will need to review and that may add 3-5 business days. Also require NDA before sharing any detailed findings.

leah_sales: Action: @procurement_acme send the redline if any; @tony_se provide presign + window; @maria_compliance route signoff. I'll update Acme with the caveats and the pricing ballpark.

procurement_acme: Sent redline: add "Acme Corp, San Jose" to signatory. No other changes.

maria_compliance: Received 94 routing to legal, low risk. Expect sign-off within 48h.

ops-bot: Staging ready: allowlist IP 54.86.11.101/32, presign URL (24h): https://s3-redwood.example/presign/acme-poc/report.zip?token=XXX (placeholder).

leah_sales: Thanks all. I'll share the final packet once legal signs and will flag here if pricing quote arrives. :thumbsup:
